purpose: Capture currently available lifetime post metrics for the Wilfred experiment and three image controls

scope.identity_check: Each returned from.id must equal expected_from_page_id before accepting metrics.

missing_metric_policy: Use null and quality_status=missing; never use zero unless Meta explicitly returns zero.
reason_for_scope: Use the currently available post-object metrics only; do not request read_insights or infer unavailable values.
next_step_if_success: Store six validated snapshots and compare Wilfred vs control descriptively.
next_step_if_error: Stop and record the exact error; do not change token or retry automatically.
